title: New default-agent conversation
description: AGENT-NEW-1: the reply to `POST /v1/agent/default/chat:new {"confirmed": true, "expected_provider_session_id": <the conversation the client shows>}`. A fresh codex thread in the agent workspace becomes the default conversation; the old thread is kept by codex (`previous_kept`), never archived or deleted, and core's record keeps `previous_thread_id`. `snapshot` is the new, empty conversation. Every open event stream gets `{"type": "resync_required"}` and the state publishes `agent.changed` with an idle face. Refusals (409): `new_conversation_confirmation_required`, `agent_identity_changed` (the client is looking at a conversation that is no longer the default - another device started one), `agent_turn_active` (a turn is running), `agent_approval_pending` (a question waits for the person), `agent_conversation_changing` on other chat routes while it happens. Native and web credentials; one journal line `{"omodachi":"agent","event":"agent.conversation.new","device","role","previous_thread_id","outcome","thread_id"?}`.
